Minor gaps: isSlugCollision retries on any unique/integrity error, not only the slug one (CreateEntity.php:94-104).

conventions.evidence: Entity creation is a domain write done inline in the Livewire component instead of an app/Actions class (CreateEntity.php:38-50); submit() never calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class) although the policy exists (CreateEntity.php:20-25), violating Livewire policy rule 3; Dashboard and pick check membership by hand (`abort_unless($user && $user->membershipFor(...))`, Dashboard.php:17; EntityController.php:39) instead of the EntityPolicy view ability; CHANGELOG.md not updated. Positives: #[Validate] + validate(), #[Fillable] set deliberately, docs/database-schema.md updated, Bulma markup and existing <x-form-field>/<x-button> components reused.

security.evidence: Membership checks on pick (EntityController.php:39), dashboard mount (Dashboard.php:17) and middleware (CurrentEntity.php:45-51); role hard-coded to Owner server-side (CreateEntity.php:45-46); name validated; all output escaped with {{ }}; fillable set. Gaps of limited impact: CreateEntity::submit has no policy authorize call (policy currently allows all authenticated users, so little real impact); current_entity is not registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, though Dashboard has no actions today.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityImplementationTest.php covers schema, second-owner DB rejection, scopes/relations, every policy ability, guest redirects, onboarding title/heading in both locales, /home dispatch, slug increment, insert-time retry via uniqueSlug override, validation failure, dashboard 403 for non-member, middleware edge cases, switcher markup, pick 403 with untouched session, navbar link. Missing: Livewire unauthorized-call test for submit and a tamper test (e.g. trying to set a role/extra property), required by the Livewire definition of done.

simplicity.evidence: TenantContext has redundant accessors get()/entity() and is aliased twice in the container ('tenant', 'current_entity') plus duplicated into two request attributes (CurrentEntity.php:58-60, AppServiceProvider.php:18-21) — speculative; the 0/1/>1 dispatch logic is duplicated between the middleware and the /home closure (routes/web.php:22-41); isSlugCollision uses seven overlapping heuristics (CreateEntity.php:94-104).

readability.evidence: Clear names and short methods; helpful comments (CreateEntity.php:33-34, migration owner_seq comment); PHPDoc generics on relations. Business logic sits in a route closure in routes/web.php:21-42, which is less maintainable than a controller method.

scope.evidence: Nearly everything serves the task; no members/settings pages, no locale middleware. Small extras: 'tenant'/'current_entity' container aliases and request attributes not asked for (AppServiceProvider.php:20-21, CurrentEntity.php:19-20,59-60).

issues.explanation: Entity + owner creation is a domain write done directly in the Livewire component rather than through an app/Actions class that authorizes inside, as the conventions require.
submit() does not call $this->authorize('create', Entity::class); the Livewire security policy (rule 3, blocking in review) requires server-side policy authorization on every public action.
Membership is checked by hand with membershipFor() instead of going through EntityPolicy::view via authorize, bypassing the new policy.
No unauthorized-call or tamper test for the CreateEntity Livewire action, both mandated by the Livewire definition of done.
isSlugCollision treats any unique/integrity/duplicate error as a slug collision, so unrelated constraint failures are silently retried up to 10 times.
Membership-count dispatch logic is duplicated between the /home closure and the middleware, and lives in a route closure rather than a controller.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] is not updated despite a significant feature addition.
Redundant get()/entity() accessors and two extra container aliases plus request attributes are speculative surface not required by the task.
current_entity is not registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it would stop applying to future Dashboard actions on /livewire/update.

review.summary: The change implements the full entity data model (with the DB-level single-owner constraint), policies, tenant middleware, onboarding with insert-time slug retry, switcher, dashboard and navbar link, with a broad and meaningful test suite. However, the onboarding write bypasses the required app/Actions pattern and the Livewire action never authorizes through the policy (a blocking item in the project's Livewire policy), membership checks bypass the new policies, and there is some duplication and speculative tenant-context surface, so it needs changes before merging.
